title: Replay arm B runs live on a token-matched static CLAUDE.md
body:
Split of S8 (t-1ntztra), machinery step. ADR 0021 point 7: arm B is the in-force records rendered to a static CLAUDE.md, token-matched to arm C's injection (C may not inject more tokens than B). evals/replay/arms.ts carries only the staticRecords flag; no renderer and no live arm-B row exist.
Outcome: node evals/replay/run.ts --arms B runs live rows like --arms C (evals/replay/arm-c.ts): the unit base checkout gets a CLAUDE.md rendered from the in-force records, no hooks, same sandbox, model, budget and permission mode as A and C (shared argument builder, closes t-gv3cf1g); the renderer reports its token count and the arm-C injection token count of the same row.
Proof: node evals/replay/run.ts --arms B --units 1 prints verdict:; a unit test asserts A, B and C session argv differ only in arm-owned parts.
